label: KODAK VISION3 200T 5213/7213
source: Kodak technical data H-1-5213 (March 2026 edition), curves traced from the PDF's raster figures (pages 3-4)

spectral_sensitivity.unit: log10 sensitivity (reciprocal of exposure in erg/cm2 for density 0.2 above D-min); curves end where the source plot ends them (no floor clipping, y axis 0.0-4.0)

notes: Approximate digitization; not supplied or endorsed by Eastman Kodak Company. Differences from the 50D datasheet figures: sensitometric exposure reads '3200K 1/50 sec' (top axis log exposure -3.684 / -1.284 / 1.116 lux-seconds); spectral sensitivity reads 'Effective Exposure: 1/25 sec', 'Process: ECN -2', its y labels 0.0-4.0 sit on their own grid lines and the curves end inside the plot (not at a floor); dye density plot header reads 'Process: ECN-2; D-mins subtracted', x axis runs 400-800 nm and minimum is the dashed Minimum Density curve as plotted (ends near 787 nm); granularity plot has no B curve. Sensitometric densities made non-decreasing (largest change 0.0000, g).

granularity.value: log10 diffuse RMS granularity (sigma D x 1, 48 um aperture)
granularity.note: Diffuse RMS granularity, same datasheet raster figure; x shifted so the plot's green density curve equals the sensitometric green density at 0 stops (1.363), i.e. log relative exposure 2.494 is 0. The source plot draws only G and R granularity curves; the B curve is absent (only a 'B' legend mark is printed), so no b channel is given. G and R overlap below about log E 2.0 and above about log E 4.6 (plot units) and share the traced band centre there. The datasheet plot has no blue granularity curve; the model derives blue as green x (blue/green ratio of the Vision3 250D data) at the same relative exposure.

scan.note: fitted to 97 Lomography community scans (lomography.com/films/871968838-kodak-vision3-200t/photos, recent, pages 1-2, 2026-11-11); colours of real scans, not manufacturer data
